field.name: nh_kh1
field.join: left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh

field.name: nh_kh2
field.join: left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh

field.name: nh_kh3
field.join: left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh

field.name: rg_code
field.join: left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh
field.operation: c.rg_code in (select rg_code from sysregioninfo a where exists(select 1 from sysregioninfo b where rg_code like '%s%' and a.rg_ref like b.rg_ref + '%'))
